listings.title: Established bakery-café in Toronto’s west end
listings.lease_details: 7 years left on the lease, with an option to renew
listings.training: The owner stays for 3 months to train you and introduce wholesale customers.
listings.reason: The owner is retiring after 14 years.
included: Website, phone number and social accounts
highlights: Busy corner unit with a patio and steady foot traffic
Wholesale accounts with 6 local cafés bring in about 30% of sales
Fully equipped kitchen, replaced in 2022
description: A well-loved neighbourhood bakery-café with a loyal morning crowd and a growing wholesale side. Bread, pastries and custom cakes are made on site every day.
Sales have grown each year since 2021. A trained head baker and two supervisors run day-to-day operations, so a new owner does not need to be a baker.
listings.ideal_buyer: An owner-operator with retail or food experience, or a café group adding a location.
documents: Financial statements for the last 3 years
Wholesale customer list (names shared after a meeting)

listings.title: Prairie Roots Catering: corporate and event catering in Winnipeg
listings.training: 6 weeks of training, plus introductions to the 3 largest corporate clients.
listings.reason: Moving to Ontario to be closer to family.
included: Website, phone number and social accounts
highlights: Repeat contracts with offices and two universities
Licensed commercial kitchen and a refrigerated van
Booked weddings into next summer
description: A catering company known for local, seasonal menus. About 60% of sales come from corporate lunches and recurring office orders, which keeps weekday cash flow steady.
The brand, recipes, booking system and wedding calendar all transfer to the buyer.
listings.ideal_buyer: A chef or food entrepreneur who wants an established client base from day one.
documents: Financial statements for the last 3 years

listings.title: Kitchen and bathroom renovation company, Greater Toronto Area
listings.lease_details: Showroom and shop lease, 3 years left
listings.training: The owner stays for 6 months to hand over supplier and trade relationships.
listings.reason: The owner wants to step back and focus on another business.
included: Website, phone number and social accounts
highlights: Booked work worth about $700,000 for the next 5 months
Two project managers and 9 trades on staff
4.8 stars from more than 200 reviews
description: A residential renovation company specializing in kitchens and bathrooms across Peel and Halton. Most work comes from referrals and repeat customers.
Systems for quoting, scheduling and warranty follow-up are in place, so the business does not depend on the owner for day-to-day work.
listings.ideal_buyer: A contractor looking to grow, or an operator with construction management experience.
documents: Financial statements for the last 3 years

listings.title: Courier and warehousing company seeks a partner (30% stake)
listings.training: The owner stays and runs the business. The partner would lead sales or finance.
listings.reason: Raising money to open a second warehouse in Ottawa.
highlights: Contracts with 3 national retailers
Fleet of 12 vans and 2 trucks
On-time delivery rate above 98%
description: Northside Logistics handles last-mile delivery and short-term storage for retailers and online stores across the GTA.
The owner is looking for an active partner who can invest and help lead the expansion to Ottawa.
listings.ideal_buyer: An investor-operator with logistics, sales or finance experience.
documents: Financial statements for the last 3 years

listings.title: Residential solar installer with a strong pipeline, Calgary
listings.lease_details: Office and warehouse lease, 5 years left
listings.reason: The founders are moving into commercial solar.
included: Website, phone number and social accounts
highlights: More than 1,400 homes installed
Approved installer for the provincial rebate programs
Sales pipeline worth $2.1 million
description: Brightline Solar designs and installs rooftop solar for homes in southern Alberta. The business has its own crews, a warehouse and a strong local brand.
listings.ideal_buyer: A trades or energy company expanding into solar, or an experienced operator.
documents: Financial statements for the last 3 years

listings.title: Women’s clothing boutique on a busy downtown street, Halifax

listings.training: 4 weeks of training and buying-trip introductions.
listings.reason: The owner is starting a family.

About $60,000 of stock included in the price
12,000 Instagram followers

listings.title: Bookkeeping practice with 60 recurring clients, Ottawa

Almost all work is cloud-based and remote
Client retention above 90% a year

Financial statements for the last 3 years

Brand name, website and 4,000 email subscribers
Fabric and notions stock
